post.description:
Self-service reset for staff. Students reset through their school
(teacher-issued temporary password), never by self-service.

get.description: Milestone-based academic progress grade per school, rolled up to the next level down.
Counts only: administrators never see the names of flagged children.
Improvement-based recognition: most improved schools, and their teachers' earned badges.

Division -> district analysis for the map: schools (onboarded and in the
registry), teachers, students and outcome metrics, within the admin's scope.
Districts/blocks the admin may use in filters and forms.

post.description: Record marks for an offline (paper) test.
School-mediated recovery: only the student's class teacher may reissue a password.

get.description: Weekly priority list: students with competencies needing practice, with evidence.
Supervision view: assistant exchanges flagged by the safety filter.

post.description: Draft MCQs from the textbook passages; saved as *draft* bank questions for teacher approval.

A head teacher (school supervisor) launches an approved lesson plan for a
class whose subject teacher is absent. Students see it as a supervised lesson.

get.description: Approved plans in the teacher's school (for the substitute workflow).

Answers the engine could not grade with confidence. Nothing here counts
towards a learner record until a teacher confirms the marks.
Approved bank questions at a difficulty matched to demonstrated mastery.

post.description: Score practice answers deterministically and record them in the learner record.

get.description: An approved lesson launched today for the student's class (e.g. substitute lesson).

Offline bundle for the signed-in user, built with the same scope rules
as the online APIs. Answer keys are never included.
Public: module names, enabled languages, demo flag.

post.description: State administrators ingest authorised material (validated upload).

get.description:
Planned / taught / learned grade per class-subject, with corrective actions.
`scope=school` (head teacher only) covers every class in the school.

post.description: Any teacher of the school can report a fault or a repair (audited).
